article.title: Change History
article.p: In this section we highlight headline changes between the major releases. For full details of changes between maintenance releases, see the SaxonC Release Notes, and for details of bug fixes see the SaxonC project at the Saxonica community site.

ul.li: Updated the core XSLT processor to the Java Saxon 9.9.1.6 version.

Replaced the method getXslMessages() method from the XsltProcessor and Xslt30Processor with the method setupXslMessages(boolean show, const char filename=NULL). This new methods gives users the option to show xsl:message output print to the standard error listener (by default). Alternatively the xsl:message output can be sent to the given file name.
Multi threading feature added to the processors XsltProcessor, Xslt30Processor and XQueryProcessor (see: bug issue #4428)
Updated the core XSLT processor to the Java Saxon 9.9.1.5 version.
Updated APIs: Support for XSLT 3.0, XQuery 3.1, XPath 3.1 and Schema Validation 1.0/1.1.

Added a feature rich XSLT 3.0 processor API to the languages: C++, PHP 7.2 and Python. Therefore two XSLT Processor classes are now available for each language supported:
C++ APIs: XsltProcessor and Xslt30Processor
Python APIs: PyXsltProcessor and PyXslt30Processor
PHP APIs: Saxon\XsltProcessor and Saxon\Xslt30Processor
Added Python3 API to the suite of programming languages supported by SaxonC. The Python extension was implemented using Cython.
Updated to Excelsior JET Enterprise 15.3 (MP1) cross compiler tool.
Additional methods in the APIs for XSLT and XQuery in C++ and PHP. (Also supported in the new Python API.)
XML Catalog file support in SaxonC.

SaxonC (all editions) can load stylesheets generated in the form of SEF files either by SaxonC itself, or by SaxonJ-EE 9.9. SaxonC-EE can also generate SEF files for use by SaxonJ, SaxonC, or SaxonJS.

The following bugs have been fixed:
Bug #2055: Apache allocates a lot of memory without releasing it
Bug #3837: Cannot locate the built PHP extension in Saxon/HE for Mac OS X
Bug #4274: Using a catalog file with Saxon in PHP
Bug #4302: High memory usage with SaxonC + PHP
Updated the core XSLT processor to the Java Saxon 9.8.0.4 version.
Updated APIs: Support for XSLT 3.0, XQuery 3.1, XPath 2.0/3.0 and Schema Validation 1.0/1.1.
Added XDM Data Model API in support of the specs XPath, XQuery, XSLT and Schema Validation.
Support for user defined functions. Users can now write their functions in C++/PHP and invoke them in XSLT, XQuery and XPath.
Support for PHP7 distribution
Windows SaxonC builds
Updated to Excelsior JET 11.3 (MP1) cross compiler tool
Revised API for XSLT and XQuery in C, C++ and PHP
